text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired: PD#INC-8241 -> gpu-host-17.rack17 (kernel-oops) + kubelet NotReady. Auto-escalation to eng-oncall.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Alert routed to oncall (primary). Pager acknowledged by alex.

alex: acked. I'm on it, pulling node info.

alex: quick check: `ssh ops@gpu-host-17.rack17` fails (connection timed out). serial console attach in progress.

maria: noticed spikes in 95th latency for dedicated endpoints in us-west-2 ~ 18:12 UTC. Could be affected by this host.

sachin: copying runbook for kernel oops / kubelet notready: 
```
- check serial for oops stacktrace
- check systemd/journalctl for kubelet and driver
- try `kubectl get nodes gpu-host-17 -o wide` and `kubectl describe node gpu-host-17`
- if node unreachable and pods failing, attempt evac -> drain or scale up fallback pool
- notify CS and consider traffic steering
```

alex: `kubectl get nodes | grep gpu-host-17` -> no response, same as API timed out for node. `kubectl describe` times out.

natalie: I'm pulling tenant routing metrics. So far ~3 clusters saw failed pod starts (OOM/CrashLoop) and ~5% of dedicated GPU capacity in us-west degraded. Customer-facing: a small subset of dedicated customers on that host are seeing increased 429s.

maria: tagging @cs-team. Natalie, can you paste which customer IDs look impacted?

natalie: impacted customers: cust-314, cust-811, cust-900 (list sent to CS DM). I'll post aggregate numbers in 10m.

sachin: serial console attached, past logs show: 
```
[    2.345678] NMI: CPU stuck - possible hardware fault
[    2.346000] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt
Call Trace:
  dump_stack+0x5c/0x7d
  panic+0x1a3/0x2b6
```

alex: kernel panic on boot cycles. Host appears to be reboot-looping. Kubelet never fully registers.

maria: can we RMA or mark host failed and evacuate? What about live-evac for tenants?

alex: plan: 1) mark node unschedulable in control plane routing so new requests bypass it (we'll add to fallback). 2) scale up cpu-only fallback pool + increase autoscaler by 2 nodes. 3) try a forced drain if node responds; otherwise migrate tenants via routing policy and cancel placement to that host.

sachin: running `kubectl cordon gpu-host-17` -> command times out. No kubelet connection.

maria: stepping in — I'll open a Jira for hardware RMA and page infra-hardware. We need to avoid mass evacs that cause throttling elsewhere.

maria: @infra-hardware please triage rack17-host09 (gpu-host-17) kernel panic/reboot-loop. Serial shows repeated ECC errors prior to oops.

infra-hardware (automated notice): Received hardware triage request. Oncall EngInfra_ACK required.

alex: moving traffic away via routing policy change. Executing `redwood-route set --exclude-host gpu-host-17` now.

sachin: confirm route change propagated: 200 OK. Traffic steering applied, preferring cpu-fallback and other gpu pools.

natalie: after steering, error rate for affected customers dropped from 12% -> 4% over 8 minutes. Latency stabilized. Not fully resolved but degraded.

maria: good. Notifying CS and core-sre. @cs-team update posted.

alex: starting scale up: `terraform apply -var='worker_count+ = 2'` for fallback pool. Will monitor autoscaler events.

sachin: observed K8s events: PodKD: failedScheduling on pods pinned to gpu-host-17, KubeletNotReady events. No signs of disk corruption in kube-proxy logs.

maria: can we isolate logs for gpu-driver? If kernel panic repeatedly, probably hardware or driver issue. Prior ECC mention suggests hardware.

sachin: grabbing dmesg snippets from serial (attached earlier) and uploaded to incident ticket.

incident-bot: Created INC-8241-ticket-archived with notes and logs. Assigning to eng-oncall.

alex: handoff needed in ~20m. I'm going to stay until routing is stable and RMA requested. If still unstable, escalate to platform lead for emergency RQ.

maria: next steps checklist posted: 
- ensure fallback capacity healthy
- confirm customer-facing message via CS if impact persists >30m
- open RMA + hardware swap ticket
- update internal status page if >15% customers impacted

natalie: short update: 18:34 UTC — dropped 95th p99 latency by ~300ms for impacted endpoints. Errors trending down.

sachin: confirming no other nodes in same rack showing ECC. Running `ipmitool sel elist` on bmc proxied host. Reports several corrected ECC and one uncorrectable entry.

maria: marking host as failed in inventory: `inv mark-failed gpu-host-17 --reason 'kernel panic, uncorrectable ECC'` done. RMA ticket created: RMA-5234. ETA for tech is 4 hours.

alex: handoff to sachin in 18m (18:52 UTC). Sachin, you'll pick up monitoring, ensure CS notice if error rate >5% for another 15m, and coordinate with infra-hardware for swap.

sachin: ack. I'll keep watch and post updates.

natalie: notifying oncall rotation for tomorrow about potential follow-ups (disk firmware, BIOS, driver upgrade).

maria: closing immediate urgent loop: traffic steered, fallback nodes added, RMA initiated. Leaving monitoring open.

incident-bot: This thread will remain open until manually closed. Use `incident-bot close` to resolve.

sachin: 18:57 UTC — error rate steady at 3.8%, latency normalizing. No further action for now. Will re-open if regressions.

alex: thanks team. :thumbsup:
